name: Mpox
summary: Clade Ib mpox spreads locally in Europe and has reached Chile; UK counts 298 cases; no new emergency declared
state: WHO's 69th situation report lists community transmission of clade Ib in nine European countries, including the UK, and first reports from Chile and Hungary, with African cases stable at about 200 a week (WHO). UKHSA's 12 Nov overview counts 298 confirmed clade Ib cases in the UK, which have outnumbered clade IIb since July 2026 (UKHSA). Searches on 27 Nov found no new emergency of international concern and no sharp acceleration, so Watch holds.
for_you: Risk to the general public in the UK remains low. People in sexual networks where mpox is spreading are most exposed; NHS and UKHSA guidance covers symptoms and vaccine eligibility.
rubric_hit: Watch: clade I spreading outside Africa, with community transmission in nine European countries (WHO)

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
